title: Giraffe holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M57 38 Q54 45 52 52 Q50 58 48 63' stroke='#8A7050' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='24' rx='10' ry='13' fill='#FF5C7A'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='20' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#FF9EB0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M57 36.5 L59 39 L55.5 39 Z' fill='#D9405E'/>
  
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#F5C542'/>
  
  <!-- giraffe spots on body -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='74' r='2.2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='69' r='2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='76' r='1.8' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='29' y='80' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='36' y='81' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='4' height='12' rx='2' fill='#F5C542'/>
  <rect x='50' y='81' width='4' height='11' rx='2' fill='#F5C542'/>
  
  <!-- hooves -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='92' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='92' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='92' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M33 68 Q28 55 26 42 L34 40 Q36 54 40 66 Z' fill='#F5C542'/>
  
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='58' r='2' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='36' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#F5C542'/>
  
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='26' y1='30' x2='23' y2='22' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='21' r='2.5' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='30' x2='36' y2='22' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='21' r='2.5' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='34' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F5C542' transform='rotate(-20 21 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='34' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#F5C542' transform='rotate(20 39 34)'/>
  
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='40' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#E8B236'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='34' r='2' fill='#3A2C10'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='2' fill='#3A2C10'/>
  <circle cx='27.6' cy='33.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6D0'/>
  <circle cx='34.6' cy='33.3' r='0.7' fill='#FFF6D0'/>
  
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='40' r='0.7' fill='#B07A18'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='40' r='0.7' fill='#B07A18'/>
  
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M25 43 Q27 44.5 30 43' stroke='#B07A18' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M34 31 Q37 33 35 36 Q38 38 35 41' stroke='#C98A1E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <path d='M48 65 Q50 60 52 56' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M56 72 Q62 74 63 80' stroke='#F5C542' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='81' r='2.5' fill='#C98A1E'/>
</svg>
